text:
maya: Heads up — after the eviction-policy rollout to eu-west yesterday we started seeing a small but consistent spike in structured output rejections for function invocations. ~0.6% -> 2.3% on the Canary slice. Not sure if it's kv cache evictions or the stricter validator.
jonathan: Saw those charts this morning. Looks correlated with sequence length > 1024 and concurrent kvcache churn.
maya: Here's a sample error from the validator: `ERROR: fncall-schema: missing required field \"result\" after coercion`
sara: Can you paste the request payload (redacted)? trying to see if model returned truncated json or the adapter stripped fields.
maya: pasted minimal sanitized payload: `{\n  \"tool\": \"summarize\",\n  \"args\": {\n    \"text\": \"<redacted>\"\n  },\n  \"kv_prefix_len\": 128\n}`
alex: If kvcache eviction happens mid-response we might end up with truncated streaming chunks, which our validator currently treats as full-schema rejects.
jonathan: Right — two axes: 1) streaming truncation -> coerce partial body, 2) validator strictness. For canary we flipped `output.strict=true`. Maybe too aggressive.
maya: ops-bot shows rollout tag `evict-policy-v2` deployed at 2025-11-09T23:14Z to 15% traffic.
ops-bot: Deploy evict-policy-v2 -> canary=15% by @maya. Release ID: r-evict-v2-20251109. :rocket:
jonathan: Proposal: change validator to soft-fail for fncalls when streaming-related EOFs are detected, increment a counter `fncall.partial_rejects` and show it in the console next to hard rejects. Then revert strict=true for the longer tails.
sara: Agree. We also need a better telemetry tag: route_id + eviction_window + kv_prefix_len so we can slice charts. Right now console groups by model+route only.
alex: Quick config snippet we could try in runtime to detect mid-response kv eviction:
```
if (streaming && bytes_received < content_length) {
  mark_as_partial();
  emit_metric("fncall.partial_detected", 1, {route, slice});
  allow_soft_validate();
}
```
jonathan: Also add an alert when partial_detected > 0.5% and hard_rejects jump by x%. We should avoid silent rollbacks.
maya: UX ask for Console: show both absolute counts and ratio (partial / total fncalls) + link to sample traces. Without sample trace linking the metric is useless.
sara: I'll open a console ticket for a new panel and a trace drilldown view. Tagging product for priority.
ops-bot: Ticket opened: CONSOLE-1289 "Partial fncall rejects panel" assigned to @sara.
alex: For short term hotfix: flip `output.strict` to false for canary > 5% traffic and enable sampling of raw tool responses (store only first 1000 chars + sha) to debug.
maya: Sounds good. Can we also increase sampling rate from 1% -> 5% for affected routes for the next 6 hours?
jonathan: I'll push a patch to routing layer to bump sampling for routes matching `summarize-*` when evict-policy tag present. Pushing in 5m.
sara: Make sure sampled traces are redacted and flagged `debug_only` in logs retention policy.
maya: Thanks — let's watch dashboards and regroup in 2 hours. :eyes:
